Quick‑start

A 10‑line snippet to run DeepRM on a demo file:

from inference.pileup import run_pileup
import numpy as np

demo_npz = "tests/demo_prediction.npz"
pm6a, dom = run_pileup(demo_npz)
print(pm6a[:4], dom[:4])
